A07 census rules, written before the census runs (G39's order test). Each ruled line gets the class it was ruled under. Instantiate (A07-inst-spec.txt): O and M the order (M named in words), J joint, ONE one end, BOUND2 bound, OTHER and P-G6 other; BOUND's three lines (archlinux-047, fireemblem-039, starryknights-037) take the class of their re-ruling, an early marking. Restrict (A07-restrict-spec-105.txt): S-O and S-M the order (S-M named in words), S-BOUND bound, S-HELD an early marking where its evidence names an early marking or credit, else held, EL limit of evidence, FAM the family. Add, add-step and contradict (A07-adds.jsonl): bound where the reason names A07's own bound, the order where it restates A07's connection with the order shown, the family for an elaboration, el for kind none, other for the particular, else held. Absent (A07-absent.jsonl): a reject is the order (named in words where its reason says a plain report), the specification is one end, an accept with kind none is a limit. Every class is checked against the written decision and kind. A room is counted in each class its lines show, then once by priority: order, bound, joint, early, family, held, one, el, other, limit. An episode is the order or the bound; the share of the order is read against C2's 139 of 182 (0.764; null mean 0.378, p95 0.434), and again with the joint-only and early-only rooms added to the denominator, since those rooms show a marking that the order cannot place after a report
